data.name: HALLS
data.detailed_description:
HALLS is a co-op survival horror game set in a liminal space for 1-6 players. You end up stranded inside of the backrooms. Explore to gather resources, protect your base and craft gear to hunt giant bosses. Will you be able to find a way out of this space in between worlds?

EXPLORE TOGETHER

Split up or stick together as you explore this procedurally generated game world, that changes every playthrough. In order to gather resources and find a way out of this hell.

SURVIVE

In order to stay alive you must protect yourself and your homebase from roaming entities and other different anomalies. Keep yourself sane, gear up and make sure you are always stocked up on the essentials in order to survive.

CRAFT

Using the resources you have gathered you can create new devices, upgrade your base, as well as craft weaponry and other useful items that will help you during your exploration of the vast landscape surrounding you.

HUNT

While you are initially fleeing from all sorts of horrors in order to stay alive, you will eventually be able to take on the entities that have been terrorizing you ever since you woke up in this place. Doing so rewards your with high-end loot that will be essential for your escape.

Do you have what it takes?
